svg.desc: Visitor column reflects all locked decisions: dynamic location, intelligent zoom rule, geolocation prompt on first chip tap with IP fallback, diversified event categories, Details CTA, 10-purpose taxonomy, language pill kept on cover plus navigator.language detection. Block status moved to BACKLOG v0.2. Center column now fully details the 8 auth triggers and the 6-step Signup module. Signed-in column placeholder.
svg.text: Visitor vs Signed-in · v8 — signed-in column rebuilt · Concierge postponed · Threads + Profile + Host detailed
Signed-in column rebuilt per 2026-05-28 review · Concierge ★ postponed to v0.2 · 7 auth triggers (was 8) · full sub-spec in DEV_SPEC_v0.1_signedin.md
VISITOR · LOCKED
5 surfaces · 0 write actions · bottom-nav visible · Concierge ★ preview-only
AUTH TRIGGERS · 7 + SIGNUP
all funnel into the 6-step phone-only signup
SIGNED-IN
6 surfaces · detailed sub-spec in DEV_SPEC · ⑥ Concierge → v0.2

g.text: ① Cover · /
• Sheep logo + "TagAlng." wordmark (real iOS status bar above)
HERO · "Find your fellows in a 5-minute walk."
• Sub: "One sentence about you. We show you the block."
INTAKE CARD
• Text input → seeds claim · "Show me my block →" CTA
4 EXAMPLES · hardcoded in v0.1 · Sanity CMS in v0.3
• v0.1 fallback: Postpartum · Brunch · Yoga · Doula
• Sanity wires in BEFORE 2nd market launch (see BACKLOG P1·#4)
FOOTER + LANGUAGE PILL
• "Free to explore · phone only when you tag along · Sign in"
• EN / ES / PT pill kept on cover (per your call)
LANGUAGE LOGIC · device-detect + user override
• Default = navigator.language · es-* / pt-* / fallback en
• Tap pill = override · persists tagalng-lang in localStorage
② Atlas / Map · visitor mode
DYNAMIC LOCATION (not static Lake Nona)
• Mapbox centers on user's detected location
• Source: navigator.geolocation · fallback: IP-based region
GEOLOCATION UX · best-practice ladder
• Don't ask on cover (cold ask = poor conversion)
• Ask on FIRST chip tap (warm context: "to show your block")
• If denied · IP region · banner: "Tap to enable for better matches"
• Re-prompt available in Profile · Settings · once-per-week max
INTELLIGENT ZOOM · rule v1
• Load: fit-to-bounds containing nearest 3-5 peers (min)
• If <3 peers within 5 mi → expand to nearest 10 (max 10 mi)
• Bounds: minZoom 11 (city) · maxZoom 18 (block)
• User manual zoom: respected · "Re-center" pill after 30s idle
HEADER PILL · dynamic content
• "TagAlng. · [Detected neighborhood] · X fellows · Y events"
• Counts reflect visible-bounds (zoom-aware)
EVENT CATEGORIES · diversified
• Faith small group · Running club · Walking the dog
• Park playdate · Coffee + stroller · Brunch · Yoga · Postpartum
UPPER-RIGHT = PROFILE BUTTON (was filter)
• Tap → Profile screen (signed-in) · → auth gate (visitor)
BLOCK STATUS BAR → moved to BACKLOG v0.2 (P0·#1)
③ Event detail · CARD + FULL-SCREEN PAGE
SUBSECTION A · Event CARD on map
• Banner thumb · title · time · venue area · X going · match score
• CTA: "Details →" (Apple/Google nav-style · highest CTR pattern)
SUBSECTION B · Event FULL-SCREEN PAGE
• Header · banner · title · date/time
• Location: venue area only · full address post-approval
B.1 · AFFINITY · standalone colored block
• "5 of 7 affinities match" prominent
• Each affinity as colored tag · same palette as claim cards
gold · coral · sage · plum · navy
B.2 · HOSTED BY · clickable (blurred for visitor)
• Blurred host avatar + nickname pre-signin
• Tap → host's profile · gates to signup at first action
B.3 · ABOUT (narrative)
• Short paragraph from host · "what we do, vibe"
B.4 · PURPOSE · 10-category taxonomy (NEW)
• 🕊 Faith small group · 💸 Fundraiser · 🤝 Meet+greet
• 🛋 Hangout · 🍱 Lunch & learn · 🎓 Mentoring (1:1 / group)
• 🏃 Workout/Sports · ℹ️ Info session · 🎨 Activity/Hobby
• 🌿 Care/Support · plus "Recurring" toggle (one-off vs weekly)
④ Block status sheet · MOVED TO BACKLOG (v0.2 P0·#1)
• Ship PWA without it · log as #1 backlog item
• See BACKLOG.md · 3-state bar (No-one / Waitlist / Live)
• Reasoning: Day-Zero conversion driver · biggest cold-start risk
• Effort: ½ day frontend · ½ day backend · 1h copy
⑤ Creator Tiers · MOVED to signed-in column (Profile)
• Only visible to users with an existing profile · not for visitors
• Will detail in next iteration's signed-in spec
⑥ Theme + Language · cross-cutting
LANGUAGE · device-detect + on-cover override
• On load: read navigator.language → es-* / pt-* / fallback en
• EN/ES/PT pill kept on cover · tap = override · persists
• Once signed in, override also available in Profile · Settings
PWA does see Chrome/OS language via navigator.language — both work
THEME
• Default: follow OS prefers-color-scheme · light / dark
• Override in Profile · Settings · persists tagalng-theme
VISITOR CANNOT
✗ Request to join · ✗ Nudge · ✗ Open Threads / Profile screens
• ✗ Create event · ✗ See unblurred host nickname / address
• ✗ Approve/decline · ✗ Edit claims · ✗ Concierge ★ beyond preview
7 PLACES THE GATE FIRES · ranked by intent + LTV
① Cover · "Sign in" link
explicit · highest user intent · opens signup directly
② Event detail page · "Request to join →"
picked a specific event · highest conversion intent · auto-files request post-signup
③ Atlas · cover-chip tap (warm geo-permission ask)
first chip = first geolocation prompt + opens visitor Atlas (NOT signup directly)
④ Atlas · tap a blurred peer avatar
curiosity · peer sheet shows blurred preview · CTA → signup
⑤ Bottom-nav · Threads tab
visitor can SEE the nav now · tap Threads → auth gate "just your phone →"
⑥ Bottom-nav · Profile (top-right of Atlas)
your claims only render after signup step 5 · visitor sees Auth gate
⑦ Bottom-nav · + (Host event · centered)
create-event needs verified host identity · highest LTV (supply side)
AUTH GATE SHEET · single surface · same for all 8 triggers
• "Sign up · just your phone →"
• Branch param records WHICH trigger drove conversion
• Closes back to original surface on dismiss · resumes on signup-complete
SIGNUP MODULE · 6 steps · phone-only
Step 1 · Phone
+1 country picker · phone input · "Send code →"
Twilio SMS via Supabase Auth phone provider
Step 2 · OTP
6 boxes · auto-advance · Resend link
paste handler · 30s cooldown on Resend
Step 3 · Block
"Use my location" → already-permissioned geo
or type zip · "Nearby blocks" list
Step 4 · Identity
one-line free text · example chips · no mic in v0.1
seeded from cover input if user typed there
Step 5 · Profile
claim cards · inline-editable · % match · synonyms
Aki's embedding pipeline (v0.2 real · v0.1 mock)
Step 6 · Fellows
12 peers · NICKNAMES ONLY · "See them on the map →"
resumes original trigger flow afterward
NOT collected here · email · Apple/Google · nickname · photo
(nickname + photo collected lazily on first action that needs them)
Backend hand-off · Supabase Auth · Twilio · users.identity_claims · users.cluster_id
RLS rules locked at end of signup · all subsequent writes go via authed RPCs
Trigger funnel · ranked
• Highest reach · ③ chip tap → opens Atlas with geo prompt
• Highest conversion intent · ② "Request to join"
• Highest LTV · ⑦ + Host event (creators)
• Cleanest measurable · ① "Sign in" link (always intent)
Branch param · attribution schema
• ?signup_trigger=request_to_join&event_id=yoga
• Lands in signups.trigger + signups.context_id
• Funnel analytics in v0.3 · BACKLOG P2 candidate

2. PWA push notifications · request approved / nudge / check-in reminder
3. Chat composer in event threads · gated by shared-event attendance

5. Founder badges UI grant flow · 6. Voice intake (mic enabled) · 7. Map-pin clustering
P2 · ships in v0.4 · post-PMF
8. Identity verification (selfie + ID) · 9. Creator Tier gating + Stripe Connect · 10. Multi-cluster · 11. Admin moderation UI
P3 · parked (no v0.x slot)
Child profiles · Inner Circle · Audio rooms · Event photo gallery · Recurring event templates

Events tab · sub-filters: [Hosting] [Attending] [Past]

9 subsections — full spec in DEV_SPEC.md ④
1. ✏️ Pencil edit (top-right) · edit nickname/photo/intake/privacy/notifs
2. ✓ Phone verified badge (v0.1) · email v0.2 · ID v0.4

⑤ + Host event · 10-purpose taxonomy + venue area

• 10 purposes: Faith · Running · Outdoor · Coffee · Heritage · Postpartum ·
Book club · Beauty+Wellness · Lifestyle · Kids-led
• Intake → Purpose → Time → Venue area → Details · approvals queue in Threads
• Edit-event-details reuses same flow (existingEventId param) · see ③
Visitor + Host CTA difference
• Visitor walks the entire intake · CTA flips to "Sign up to post event →"
• Draft saved to localStorage · restored after signup-complete
⑥ Cover · skipped post-signin
• Auth session detected → land directly on Atlas
• Sign-out from Profile › Settings returns to Cover
NICKNAMES ONLY · v0.1 trust floor
• Every name shown in v0.1 = NICKNAME · yours and theirs
• Real name collected at signup but NEVER displayed in v0.1
• Photo also lazy · collected on first action that needs it
• Principle: claim before reveal · identity follows IRL trust
• Why: anti-impersonation + permission ladder before names go public
Name-reveal ladder · v0.1 → v0.3+
v0.1 · nicknames everywhere · no real-name display
v0.2 · stage 3 backend wires real RSVP-approval (Ship 5 already mocks it client-side)
v0.2 · co-attendance check-in flips to stage 4 · home address mutual reveal
v0.3+ · photo unlocks similarly · email-verified badge

• All 7 triggers (Concierge dropped) → SAME 6-step phone-only signup
• Step 6 Fellows · NICKNAMES ONLY (Ship 5 fixed the 3 real-name leaks)
